cs.t: I have a Revere Ware 12 qt Stock Pot I bought 35+ years ago. The spot welds on one side of the handle of the lid have come undone. I'm going to ask my buddy with a TIG spot welder to fix it up for me and then will hand it down to my daughter some day. Has made more pots of chili, chicken soup, bone broth and pasta than I can count. Other items not nearly as old: Le Creuset 5qt Dutch Oven, Lodge 10", 12" and 6" Cast Iron Skillets, and an old Griswold 8" which I really like because it is half the thickness of the Lodge, so temp changes more rapidly and it is lighter.
cs.th: Ask HN: What are some of your “buy it for life” purchases?
